messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — noticed the console rollout page is flipping v1 to 'Deprecated' as soon as we enable fallback routing. That's misleading since requests are still served via fallback. Putting thread here to settle UX + telemetry signal to drive it.
rohit: Is that coming from frontend mapping or a backend status field?
eva: frontend — it's mapping a status string into a hard "Deprecated" banner. Users will panic if they see that but requests still work.
simon: Telemetry lag makes this trickier. Cached clients and SDKs mean traffic doesn't drop flat immediately; we only see steady-state reductions after ~6–12h in some customers. Banners that flip immediately look flaky.
maya: Proposal: backend expose a canonical serving_state with enum: "serving", "compat_mode", "deprecated". Frontend maps compat_mode -> "Compatibility mode — requests may be routed to newer compatible models (automatic fallback)".
rohit: Strong +1. Also gate the big "Deprecated" copy on an actual routing signal: only show deprecated if fallback_rate < 1% AND deprecation_flag=true for 24h.
maya: Example pseudo-query I ran for fallback rate: 
```
# pseudo-promql
sum(rate(routing_fallback_total{model=\"v1\"}[1h])) / sum(rate(routing_requests_total{model=\"v1\"}[1h])) * 100
```
Current 1h avg = ~0.6%, 24h avg = ~1.8% (so trending down).
eva: API consumers also get an X-Deprecation header today. We should expand it to an enum: X-Model-Deprecation: none|compat|deprecated so integrators can programmatically surface the right messaging.
simon: Agree. Also emit a console telemetry event console_shown_deprecation{model,serving_state,rollout_id} so we can correlate support tickets.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/console-copy-change deployed to staging at 1738210000
maya: UI copy question: "Deprecated (compatibility mode on)" vs "Compatibility mode — v1 will be removed; fallback in place". Which reads clearer?
eva: "Compatibility mode — requests may be routed to newer models automatically. Check your integrations." Short and actionable.
simon: I want to be conservative with the word "Deprecated". Only show that when serving_state == "deprecated" AND observed_fallback_rate < 0.5% for 24h. Otherwise use "Compatibility mode".
rohit: I'll add a migration CTA in the banner linking to /docs/migrate-v1 and a quick checklist (SDK pinning, header checks).
maya: Backend should also surface observed_fallback_rate windows (1h/24h) in the status payload so frontend can show "Observed fallback: 0.6% (1h avg)" — helps users interpret the banner.
eva: Good idea. Also add a short tooltip explaining why requests still succeed.
simon: I'll own the backend changes: add serving_state enum, X-Model-Deprecation header enum, telemetry event, and rollout_state log field. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
maya: I'll update console copy, implement the gating logic, and add the migration CTA + translations.
rohit: I'll update docs and add a small note in the SDK changelog.
eva: Can ops-bot ping customer-success when we flip prod copy? We should notify large customers.
notification-bot: will notify #customer-success upon prod rollout (configurable recipients).
maya: OK checklist mapped: simon -> backend field/header/telemetry, maya -> console copy+metric+tooltip, rohit -> docs+migration CTA. We'll only flip to explicit "Deprecated" copy after the 24h stable window and fallback_rate threshold.
simon: I'll also include rollout_state=compat_mode in audit logs so SRE can search.
maya: Thanks all. Filing this as a small project in the rollout epic and will link the PRs here. :thumbsup:
rohit: Thanks — sounds safe.
eva: 👍
simon: picking up backend work now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging tests passed at 1738210500, ready for review.
